$comment: 小程序版有哪些组件、各自用网页版的哪些类名（blocks：类名去掉 __ 后面的部分）。scripts/build-mini.mjs 照这张表把网页版 CSS 分到每个组件；没列进来的网页组件不进小程序产物。has：网页版的 :has() 在小程序里换成哪个类名（组件自己加）。 skip：小程序版组件不会加的修饰类名，带它的规则不进产物。

components.name: Layout
components.summary: 竖排、横排、分隔线、页面的一段：间距都从令牌来。
components.summaryEn: Stacks, rows, dividers and page sections, with gaps from the tokens.

components.name: Text
components.summary: 标题、正文、说明、等宽字的固定几档：层级靠字号和字重。
components.summaryEn: Fixed steps for headings, body, captions and mono: hierarchy from size and weight.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: 和网页版同一套图标，颜色跟着文字走；按需引入，没用到的不进包。
components.summaryEn: The same icon set as the web kit, colored by the text; import only what you use.

components.name: Button
components.summary: 实心、次要、幽灵、危险四种；加载中、整行宽；照样能用小程序的分享、手机号这些开放能力。
components.summaryEn: Primary, secondary, ghost and danger; loading and full-width; open abilities like share still work.

components.name: Cell
components.summary: 手机上最常用的一行：标题、说明，右边是值、开关或箭头。
components.summaryEn: The most common row on phones: title and description, with a value, control or arrow on the right.

components.name: Field
components.summary: 标签、输入框、说明、出错、字数，一个字段一块。
components.summaryEn: Label, input, help, error and counter, one field per block.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: 自己画的开关，和网页版一模一样：直角模式下也是方的。
components.summaryEn: A self-drawn switch, identical to the web one: square in square mode too.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: 自己画的复选框，支持半选；整块（框和文字）都能点。
components.summaryEn: A self-drawn checkbox with an indeterminate state; the whole row is tappable.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: 一组单选：竖排或横排，可以整组禁用。
components.summaryEn: A radio group, stacked or inline, which can be disabled as a whole.

components.name: Segmented
components.summary: 两三个选项里选一个：显示方式、时间范围。
components.summaryEn: Pick one of two or three options: a view mode or a time range.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: 一排标签，选中的下面一条墨色线；多了能左右滑。
components.summaryEn: A row of tabs with an ink underline; scrolls sideways when there are many.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: 从屏幕底部升起的面板。手机上的菜单、浮动卡片都换成它；还有一列操作的 ActionSheet。
components.summaryEn: A panel that rises from the bottom. Menus and popovers become sheets on phones; ActionSheet lists actions.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: 盖在屏幕中间的确认和提醒；按手机的返回键先关它。
components.summaryEn: A centered confirm or notice; the phone's back gesture closes it first.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: 自己画的轻提示：成功、出错、可撤销，在底部安全区上面。
components.summaryEn: Self-drawn toasts for success, errors and undo, above the bottom safe area.

components.name: NavBar
components.summary: 自定义导航栏：给右上角的胶囊按钮让位，标题和胶囊对齐。
components.summaryEn: A custom nav bar that leaves room for the capsule button and lines the title up with it.

components.name: TabBar
components.summary: 底部标签栏：图标加字、角标，留出安全区。
components.summaryEn: A bottom tab bar with icons, labels, badges and the safe area.

components.name: Empty
components.summary: 还没有内容时：一个图标、一句话、一个按钮。
components.summaryEn: When there's nothing yet: an icon, a line and a button.

components.name: Loading
components.summary: 转圈、整块加载、骨架、页面顶上的加载条。
components.summaryEn: Spinners, a loading block, skeletons and a top load bar.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: 徽标和状态点：草稿、已写入、待更新、运行中。
components.summaryEn: Badges and dots: draft, saved, outdated, running.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: 头像：图片或名字的第一个字，会员外面一圈主色。
components.summaryEn: Avatars with a photo or the first letter; members get an accent ring.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: 可点选的小块：筛选、分类。
components.summaryEn: Tappable chips for filters and categories.

components.name: Card
components.summary: 卡片和图片宫格：点图放大看。
components.summaryEn: Cards and image grids; tap an image to preview it.

components.name: Appearance
components.summary: 外观设置：主题、圆角、主色、密度、按钮质感，改了全小程序马上生效。
components.summaryEn: Appearance settings: theme, corners, accent, density and finish, applied everywhere at once.

components.name: SearchBar
components.summary: 搜索框：放大镜、清空、键盘上的「搜索」提交，可以带「取消」。
components.summaryEn: A search box with clear, keyboard search and an optional Cancel.

components.name: LoadMore
components.summary: 列表底下的一行：加载中、没有更多了、出错了重试。
components.summaryEn: The row under a list: loading, no more, or retry on error.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: 进度条和用量条：上传、完成度、本月用量。
components.summaryEn: Progress and usage bars: uploads, completion, monthly usage.

components.name: Steps
components.summary: 一件事分几步：做完的打勾，当前这步是选中底加主色线；横排看进度，竖排带说明。
components.summaryEn: Multi-step flows: done steps get a check, the current step has the selected background and an accent line; horizontal for progress, vertical with notes.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: 先后发生了什么：时间在左，一根竖线串起每条；重点主色，还没发生的空心。
components.summaryEn: What happened, in order: the time on the left, one line through every entry; emphasis in the accent, what has not happened yet hollow.

components.name: Collapse
components.summary: 折叠：常见问题、更多说明，可以一次只开一个。
components.summaryEn: Collapsible sections for FAQs and details, optionally one at a time.

components.name: Swipe
components.summary: 左滑出操作：删除、置顶；竖着滑不会误打开。
components.summaryEn: Swipe left for actions like delete or pin; vertical scrolling won't trigger it.

components.name: Picker
components.summary: 底部面板里的滚轮：时间、地区、数量，手感和系统一样。
components.summaryEn: Wheels in a bottom sheet for times, places or amounts, with native feel.

components.name: Uploader
components.summary: 选图上传：宫格、进度、出错重试、移除；怎么上传由你定。
components.summaryEn: Pick and upload images: grid, progress, retry and remove; you decide where they go.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: 一个数字和它的变化，带小趋势图。
components.summaryEn: A number and how it changed, with a sparkline.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: 折线、柱状、迷你折线：画成图片，不用装 ECharts；配色和网页版同一个算法。
components.summaryEn: Line, bar and spark charts drawn as images, no ECharts needed; same palette as the web kit.

components.name: Gauge
components.summary: 一个数在一个范围里的哪儿：配额、得分、完成度。弧、半圆、整圈，区段、目标线、分格、分段、多环；和网页版同一份几何。
components.summaryEn: Where one number sits in a range: quota, score, progress. Arc, half or ring, with zones, targets, segments, stacked parts and rings; the same geometry as the web kit.

components.name: Bars
components.summary: 少类目比较、排名：名字、条、数字一行，可以标一条重点、按单位切格、正负、漏斗。
components.summaryEn: Rankings and a few categories: name, bar and number on one row, with a highlight, units, diverging bars or a funnel.

components.name: Proportion
components.summary: 一个整体分成几部分：一根横条按比例分段，图例写出数和百分比（加起来 100%）。
components.summaryEn: One whole split into parts: a bar divided by share, with a legend of values and percentages that add up to 100%.

components.name: Waffle
components.summary: 占比的单位图：10 × 10，1 格 = 1%，比饼图诚实。
components.summaryEn: A unit chart for shares: 10 × 10, one cell = 1%, more honest than a pie.

components.name: Heatmap
components.summary: 越深越多：日历（每天一格）和矩阵（星期 × 时段），横着滚。
components.summaryEn: Darker means more: a calendar (one cell a day) and a matrix (weekday × hour), scrolling sideways.

components.name: Dumbbell
components.summary: 类目级的前后对比：之前空心、之后实心，写出变化。
components.summaryEn: Before and after per category: hollow before, solid after, with the change written out.

components.name: Radar
components.summary: 轴的顺序有意义的一圈轮廓（霍兰德六边形）：网格和面积画成一张图片，名字和数字是文字；几个独立的维度用条形榜。
components.summaryEn: A profile whose axis order means something (the Holland hexagon): rings and area drawn as one image, names and numbers as text; use bars for independent dimensions.

components.name: Quadrant
components.summary: 两个维度各切一刀分成四格：当前那一格是选中底色加主色线，重点的点实心。
components.summaryEn: Two dimensions, each cut once, make four cells: the current cell has the selected background and an accent line, the highlighted point is solid.

components.name: BottomBar
components.summary: 固定在底部的一排按钮：自动留安全区、给页面底部留位置，有标签栏时摞在它上面。
components.summaryEn: A fixed row of buttons at the bottom: it keeps the safe area, reserves room at the end of the page and sits above the tab bar.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: 减一、数字、加一：件数、份数、人数，到头了按钮变灰。
components.summaryEn: Minus, number, plus for quantities; the buttons disable at the limits.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: 年月日、时分的滚轮，天数跟着年月变。
components.summaryEn: Wheels for dates and times; the days follow the year and month.

components.name: Result
components.summary: 提交成功、付款失败、审核中：一个意义色的图标、一句话、下一步。
components.summaryEn: Submitted, payment failed, under review: a tone icon, one sentence and the next step.
